title: FARADAY FUTURE INTELLIGENT ELECTRIC INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. (FFAI), an EV manufacturer trading on Nasdaq, entered into a note purchase agreement on April 17, 2026 for $45 million in aggregate financing, consisting of a $15.78 million A-1 Note and a $30 million Secured B Note, with an accredited investor. The filing describes share reserve requirements, note exchange provisions, and various conditions including a $5 million minimum shareholders' equity threshold.
key_points: Faraday Future raised $45 million via note purchase agreement on April 17, 2026
A-1 Note: $15.78 million original principal; B Note: $30 million secured note
Share reserve requirements tied to future stockholder meeting; formula based on Nasdaq minimum price rules
Note exchange provisions allow conversion of B Note portions to A Notes when A Note balance is reduced by $300,000+
Exchange conditions require minimum $5 million shareholders' equity and $5 million market capitalization
Company remains listed on Nasdaq (FFAI) with warrants trading at $110,400 exercise price (FFAIW)
